commonProtocol.version: If-Match per operation registry; profile and preferences separate resource versions
commonProtocol.unknown: Classify by operation protocol. Ordinary idempotencyKey writes preserve original actor/operation/method/path/body/key/If-Match for explicit replay; a current-resource GET never proves the original intent. Credential auth and AI resourceKey use their separate protocols below.
commonProtocol.errors: existing typed envelope/fieldErrors/currentVersion; no raw provider/DB internals
commonProtocol.dictionary: approved dictionaries.ts only, BCP47 language codes; host declarations not inferred

publicPrivateSplit: Public profile/meal allowlist excludes email, application body, private prefs/feedback and messages

proposedAlsoAppliesTo: replaceAnalyticsChoice (only after I1-C01 contract is registered as idempotencyKey)
recoverySteps: Freeze the original normalized request intent before dispatch; missing If-Match remains missing/null, not a later fetched version.
On lost response show Status unknown, retain draft and original intent. A current resource GET is only a current-state/permission check, never proof that this intent succeeded.

After current actor authorization check, an explicit retry replays original method/path/body/key and original If-Match unchanged. Server resolves actor+operation+key and payload hash and rechecks visibility before returning the sealed original result.
INTENT_IN_PROGRESS retains original intent and obeys retryAfter; payload/key mismatch rejects. Do not substitute a newer If-Match or regenerate a key to clear UNKNOWN.

A definitive original 409 is not transport UNKNOWN: keep proposal, fetch authoritative version, ask user to review and explicitly create a new intent if still desired. Expired retention similarly requires current-state review and explicit new intent, not blind replay.
counterexamples: Another device produces the same current value: GET equality does not attribute success to the lost request.
Original If-Match 7 request committed version8 but response lost: replay If-Match7/keyA, not If-Match8/keyA. Changed precondition changes request hash.

startEmail.mechanism: Existing body.clientRequestId deduplicates the same OTP-start metadata request and normalized email; keep it for a transport retry of that same start. A user-requested resend/new challenge is a distinct intent subject to 30s cooldown/expiry.
startEmail.currentClientBoundary: otp.ts currently calls newId per helper invocation; plan does not claim arbitrary repeated helper invocations preserve the first start. The implementation must distinguish retry of its retained start payload from explicit resend.

verifyEmail.mechanism: Challenge/code/PKCE and session generation, one-time consumption.
verifyEmail.lostCredentialResponse: Do not use generic ordinary-write replay or persist token response; consumed/expired code gives STATE_CONFLICT/expiry and user restarts OTP while preserving allowed original meal/draft intent.

startOAuthAndCallback.mechanism: Existing state transaction, provider nonce, PKCE and callback single-use validation. clientRequestId declaration is not a promise of replayable credentials.
startOAuthAndCallback.lostCredentialResponse: Cancel/error returns original login intent; consumed/unknown transaction or callback restarts sign-in explicitly, never fabricate authorization URL/state or auto-link by email.

exchangeHandoff.mechanism: Existing single-use bound handoff code + verifier (60s); never ordinary response table.
exchangeHandoff.lostCredentialResponse: Consumed/expired/unknown credential response requires new login/handoff, not replaying a stored access/refresh response.

refreshSession.mechanism: Existing rotating refresh token; reuse can revoke family.
refreshSession.lostCredentialResponse: No blind replay of old refresh token under a generic key. Clear unusable credentials and request sign-in according to session manager; do not resurrect an old token.

logout.mechanism: Existing current family revocation plus local private-state cleanup.
logout.lostCredentialResponse: Always clear local private credentials/context; unknown remote outcome is reported honestly, not inferred from a resource GET or called remote complete.

aiResourceKey.preferences: Existing explicit intent key + version CAS, separate from defineWrite replay. Preserve proposal and prior version; after UNKNOWN read authoritative preferences to show current state, not to prove this original request. AI_CONFLICT requires review and a new explicitly confirmed intent/version, never silent overwrite or model-body persistence.
aiResourceKey.request: Retain original requestId/session/generation and use pollAI for that exact request. Do not create another provider call to resolve UNKNOWN; cost reservation remains liable per AI contract.
aiResourceKey.lifecycle: Revalidate generation/epoch/editor identity before using a late response; no account-crossing retry.
